deviations: Table 1 and Table 2 hiring regressions are estimated as weighted least squares on exact weighted cell means over (state, month, demo2, young, prior labour-force status group), with cell weights equal to summed CPS weights. All regressors and fixed effects are constant within these cells, so point estimates are algebraically identical to the person-level aweighted regressions in YH_regs.do. This keeps the run inside the 300 s / 4 GB sandbox. Clustered standard errors (state) use the same meat and bread, but the (N-1)/(N-K) small-sample factor is omitted; they are printed for information only.

yh_data.csv was read in full (all 19,836,464 rows), but only the 19 columns the Table 1/2/10 specifications need (fread select=). The occupation/industry crosswalk merges are applied only to the new-hire wage sample.
notes: Seeded translation of YH_data_init.do and YH_regs.do: date harmonisation, state unemployment merge, potential experience from peeduca (the CSV column for Stata's peeduc), demo2 = minority x female x hispanic x 7 education levels, hired2 (excluding self-employment) x 100, young = PE<=10, and the young/old x U-rate interactions. Sample: exp and v2unemp non-missing, giving N = 16,948,516. Table 1 cols 1 and 4 (Panels A and B) and Table 2 cols 1-4 use fixest feols with state, demo2 and month FE, fixef.rm='none', and state clustering. Table 10 Panel B col 1 is run person-level on hires with v2prwernal==0: log real weekly wage on young, youngurate and oldurate, with state, date, demo2, 2002-recoded occupation and industry FE (crosswalks merged by code-year as in the do-file). Attempts 1-5 were exploratory and printed no RESULT lines. Attempt 1 timed a column-selected fread at 168 s. Attempt 2 timed raw I/O at 101 s, then crashed on a fread argument clash. Attempt 3 found 3-thread fread slower, at 205 s. Attempts 4-5 were smoke tests on the first 2M rows with RESULT renamed TEST. The final full run took 233 s, of which 221 s was reading the file. No comparison against claimed values was followed by a script change, so there are no claim attempts.
